title: fertility_quad_layout.dsl loads its mesh by a repo-root path, so it fails from ixdar-app (every launch entry and test)
description: ixdar-app/src/main/resources/dsl/fertility_quad_layout.dsl loads `ixdar-app/test/resources/quadlayout/figure_8/fertility_in_tri.off`, which only resolves when the working directory is the repo root. Launch entries, the tests and the TOOL-28 snapshot main run from ixdar-app, so the graph fails to load there (TOOL-28 had to use a sphere quad-layout graph instead). The fix was part of the archived ENG-30 and never landed. Resolve the mesh the way the other fixtures do (relative to the module or through the resource loader) and add the graph to TOOL-28's golden fingerprints.
definition-of-done:
1. The graph loads from ixdar-app and from the repo root.
2. It has a golden in GoldenFingerprintTest (tagged with the other mesh-loading goldens).
testing-plan:
1. mvn test.
2. Load it in the mesh viewer from a launch entry.
